title: Sort Colors Dutch Flag - Solution
intuition: Given an array nums with n objects colored red, white, or blue, sort them in-place so that objects of the same color are adjacent. Colors are 0, 1, 2.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use three pointers: low, mid, high. Swap 0s to low, 2s to high, and advance mid.
